claims.quote: Today is another big step forward.
claims.statement: Today's announcement is another big step forward.

claims.quote: This is fantastic news for Derby.
claims.statement: The HQ announcement is fantastic news for Derby.

claims.quote: I’m particularly pleased about the 600 apprenticeship places.
claims.statement: The 600 apprenticeship places are a particularly welcome part of the announcement.

claims.quote: This forms part of our £2.5 billion youth employment support package which is creating up to 500,000 opportunities for young people to earn or learn
claims.statement: The £2.5 billion youth employment support package is creating up to 500,000 opportunities for young people to earn or learn.

claims.quote: new development to bring estimated £151 million boost to region and hundreds of rail jobs to the city
claims.statement: The new HQ is estimated to bring a £151 million boost to the region's economy and hundreds of rail jobs to Derby.

claims.quote: Construction of the brand-new development in at Becketwell, a brownfield site in the heart of Derby city centre, is expected to begin in early 2027 and be completed by spring 2029.
claims.statement: Construction of the Becketwell HQ is expected to begin in early 2027 and be completed by spring 2029.

claims.quote: with the first starters based in Derby helping to cement the city’s role as Europe’s largest rail hub
claims.statement: Derby is Europe's largest rail hub.

claims.quote: at a time when less than 7% of the railway’s workforce is under 25
claims.statement: Less than 7% of the railway's workforce is under 25.

facts.quote: the site of Great British Railways’ (GBR) headquarters is unveiled today (15 October 2026) in Derby
facts.statement: The site of the Great British Railways headquarters has been unveiled in Derby.

facts.quote: Up to 600 apprentices between 16 and 21 years old will enrol over the next 4 years on the rail foundation apprenticeship
facts.statement: Up to 600 apprentices aged 16 to 21 are to enrol over the next 4 years on the rail foundation apprenticeship.

facts.quote: The site will accommodate up to 450 GBR staff
facts.statement: The site is planned to accommodate up to 450 GBR staff.

facts.quote: fares frozen for the first time in 30 years
facts.statement: Fares have been frozen for the first time in 30 years.

facts.quote: The announcement builds on the recent £1 billion investment in a new fleet of trains for the north set to be built at Alstom’s Derby site
facts.statement: A recent £1 billion investment in a new fleet of trains for the north has been made.

facts.quote: I’m delighted Becketwell will become GBR’s new home
facts.statement: Transport Secretary Heidi Alexander said Becketwell will become GBR's new home.

facts.quote: Work and Pensions Secretary Pat McFadden said:
facts.statement: Pat McFadden, Work and Pensions Secretary, made a statement on the foundation apprenticeship.
